name: @mixing-buddy/daw-adapters
description: Polymorphic DAW control adapters for Steinberg Nuendo and Apple Logic Pro

scripts.build:swift: mkdir -p bin && swiftc -O -framework ApplicationServices -framework Cocoa src/logic/swift/LogicAXBridge.swift -o bin/logic-ax-bridge && chmod +x bin/logic-ax-bridge && codesign -f -s - --identifier "de.oszillation-studio.mixingbuddy" bin/logic-ax-bridge
